purpose: Separate character-card backgrounds; approved portraits unchanged

prompts.ace: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: BACKGROUND ONLY for a wide character-selection portrait card in a humorous illustrated 2D rooster arcade game. Rich polished hand-painted cartoon environment, chunky simple forms, soft atmospheric depth, no photorealism, high-quality game key art. Wide landscape composition. Foreground hero character will be composited in the center later: keep central 45 percent softly lit and uncluttered, frame scene with environmental detail towards sides. Moderate contrast and soft edges so the character remains prominent. No characters, birds, animals, people, faces, weapons, eggs, lettering, UI, frame, logos or watermark. Opaque background, full bleed. Scene: a warm golden farmyard at dawn, rustic wooden coop and fence far to the sides, soft straw and grassy ground, sunbeams and floating dust in amber light. Cheerful adventurous mood. Palette warm honey gold, muted olive and brown; gentle pale golden central glow, dark warm corners.
